content: Heroism feels and never reasons, and therefore is always right.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: When crisis strikes, true heroism bypasses calculated self-interest and acts upon the noble instinct of universal compassion.
practicalInsight: Trust your generous impulses to help and protect others without calculating selfish advantage.
reflectionPrompt: When did your gut instinct guide you with greater moral clarity than intellectual calculation?
